answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one ferrous weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 209 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 241 times the capital for one share. The plume report makes public the merge explicitly at each raven. A farm of 1068 identities would post 4234 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
